column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the package tests read it. Adding a package means
# adding a row here and a project under src/ — nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
#   id      the package's name segment: the .csproj/PackageId is Net.Agora.<id>.Android
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
# Android-only, and mutually exclusive with everything above it — see the project's .csproj.
# netless's, not Agora's own, and resolved from JitPack — see the project's .csproj.
# Fastboard is NOT listed yet: src/Net.Agora.Fastboard.Android exists and resolves its
# dependencies, but class-parse still generates two colliding FastErrorEventArgs types —
# FastRoomListener and FastReplayListener both declare onFastError and neither is registered
# through an addXListener, so neither argsType nor managedName moves the generated name. Until that
# is resolved the package is not packed, so a broken binding cannot ship. Its iOS counterpart
# The optional RTC feature extensions: native payload only, no managed API, no dependency on
# either RTC package. See src/Agora.Extension.md for why they are shaped that way, and for what
# is deliberately absent (screen sharing, the -ll variants, LipSync).
